summary: Transient desk relocation, badge re-registration and scheduled asset collection for EMEA contractor
description:
Issue summary:
A contractor (short-term, 6-week engagement) needs a transient workstation in the Dublin office for the week of 2026-03-15. Current desk previously assigned to full-time headcount; desk relocation requires badge re-registration, ergonomic kit swap, and collection of loaner laptop + hotspot for return to central inventory at end of engagement.

Impact:
- Contractor cannot access secured office doors after 2026-03-14 without badge re-registration.
- Desk must be physically moved and configured prior to contractor start to avoid productivity loss.
- Asset pickup and international shipping paperwork required to return equipment to central IT stock (customs paperwork for cross-border transfer may be needed).

Environment:
- Office: Dublin (eu-west) — Building B, Floor 3, Bay 7
- Systems: Badge provisioning (Okta + HID), Inventory system (Snipe-IT), Shipping (DHL business account)

Steps required / Acceptance criteria:
1) Facilities to reseat desk and safe-mount monitor arm by 2026-03-14 EOD. Acceptance: monitor arm installed, power & KVM accessible.
2) Security/IT to re-register temporary badge with contractor profile and time-limited access (start 2026-03-15, expiry 2026-04-30). Acceptance: badge opens external doors and floor 3 turnstiles during working hours.
3) IT to provision loaner laptop (serial: LPN-EMEA-4321) + mobile hotspot and attach return shipping label with customs proforma if device will be shipped cross-border. Acceptance: devices encrypted, tracked in Snipe-IT, and labeled.
4) Logistics to schedule a one-time asset collection appointment on contractor's last day and confirm courier (DHL) booking with commercial invoice if returning from outside the Republic of Ireland. Acceptance: tracking number provided and inventory status updated to "in transit".
5) Post-change verification: Facilities, Security, and IT staff to sign off in ticket comments that handover completed.

Notes and special considerations:
- Contractor is on a short-term contractor policy; badge must be time-bound and not added to any automated group sync. Recommend manual provisioning to avoid accidental SSO access increases.
- There is a known intermittent fault with the Bay 7 turnstile (see INT-4721). If turnstile fails, provide temporary escort protocol.
- If the return shipment crosses UK border, include EORI number on commercial invoice — coordinate with finance.
- Desk has a powered sit-stand converter that requires an onsite electrician sign-off for new placement (safety check).

Suggested timeline:
- 2026-03-12: Confirm resource availability + courier rates and customs needs.
- 2026-03-14 EOD: Desk staged and badge reregistrations completed.
- 2026-04-30: Asset pickup and outbound shipping completed (or earlier if contractor leaves sooner).
